capabilities: Open any image full-screen by clicking it
Zoom with the mouse wheel centered on the pointer
Pan a zoomed image by dragging with the left mouse button
Close the viewer with Esc or by clicking the backdrop
extras: Works only in Reading mode and Live Preview mode, not Source mode; requires Obsidian v1.5.0 or later. Manual installation is the recommended install method.
intentEvidence: Designed as a drop-in replacement for the unmaintained Image Toolkit.
motivation: The README says it was built as a modern, maintainable alternative to the unmaintained Image Toolkit, with a focus on simplicity and performance.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to zoom into an image; images embedded in notes can only be viewed at their rendered size.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Image Toolkit. This plugin offers a modern, maintainable alternative

summary: Click-to-view image overlay that opens images full-screen with pointer-centered wheel zooming and drag panning in Reading and Live Preview modes.
